name: p11-kit
description: The p11-kit package provides a way to load and enumerate PKCS #11 (a Cryptographic Token Interface Standard) modules.

user:
cat >> trust/trust-extract-compat << "EOF"
# Copy existing anchor modifications to /etc/ssl/local
/usr/libexec/make-ca/copy-trust-modifications

# Update trust stores
/usr/sbin/make-ca -r
EOF

post_install: mkdir -p /var/cache/alps/sources && CERTDATA=/var/cache/alps/sources/certdata.txt && for f in /sources/certdata.txt /var/cache/alps/sources/certdata.txt; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then CERTDATA="$f"; break; fi; done && if [ ! -f "$CERTDATA" ]; then wget -O /var/cache/alps/sources/certdata.txt https://hg-edge.mozilla.org/mozilla-central/raw-file/tip/security/nss/lib/ckfw/builtins/certdata.txt && CERTDATA=/var/cache/alps/sources/certdata.txt; fi && grep -q '^# certdata.txt' "$CERTDATA" || { echo "$CERTDATA does not look like a Mozilla certdata.txt file." >&2; exit 1; } && grep -q '^# Revision:' "$CERTDATA" || sed -i "1i# Revision:$(date -u +%Y%m%d)" "$CERTDATA" && /usr/sbin/make-ca -C "$CERTDATA"
